Virtues: Conviction and Instinct

Followers (Beasts) hold that vampires are predators who stand outside civilization and need none of its trappings or technology. The Beast is the most important part of a vampire's nature, telling it when to hunt and when to rest - there's nothing wrong with either state, only with acting at the wrong time.

Hierarchy of Sin (most to least severe):

  1. Failing to survive, or failing to balance brutality with cunning
  2. Treating civilization as inherently good rather than weakening
  3. Failing to master your fears, including fire
  4. Failing to give total commitment to yourself and your packmates

Typical followers: Country @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel} (originators), some City Gangrel, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.oWsHHlI3OS7cwvaF]{Ravnos} and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} antitribu; favors Fortitude, Protean, Animalism, Auspex, Obfuscate, Celerity.

vtmlarp.source: MET Mind's Eye Theatre Sabbat Guide
